name: Light/Dark Mode
description: Follows the visitor's system color scheme, adds a light/dark toggle that is remembered, and never flashes the wrong theme on load. Gives the default theme a proper light mode.
author: Ole Eskild Steensen

settings.name: Follow system color scheme
settings.description: Until a visitor picks a mode, use their operating system's light/dark setting. Off: start in the garden's base theme.

settings.name: Show toggle button
settings.description: Adds a sun/moon button to the bottom-right corner. Off: the site only follows the system setting.

settings.name: Theme mode support
settings.description: Auto reads the installed theme's CSS for .theme-light/.theme-dark. Override when a theme only ships one mode but auto offers both, or vice versa.

settings.name: Button label
settings.description: Accessible label and tooltip for the toggle button.
